_why: The No Crash Plan, rep-facing. Built 2026-09-17.
⚠️ THIS PAGE IS NUEVA BRANDED and the funnel it explains is not. The lander, the guide and
the confirmation page all ship under EVERYDAY WELL, a neutral brand invented for this lead
magnet, so that a rep can post it into a group without it reading as an MLM pitch. This page
is the only surface in the campaign a lead never sees, which is exactly why it carries the
Nueva mark. Do not 'fix' the front end to match it.
VIDEOS ARE EMPTY ON PURPOSE, same as the other three Nueva how-to pages: no Nueva walkthrough
has been recorded, and a page with no video is honest where a page with a competitor's video
is not. Add them here and re-run the generator.
THE SUPPLEMENT GUIDE LINK RESOLVES TO NOTHING YET. nueva_no_crash_plan_supplement_pdf_url
still holds its onboarding instruction because the companion guide is not written. That is
correct on a snapshot and it is on MUST-BLANK-BEFORE-SNAPSHOT.md as a live-account check.

sub: A free fourteen day plan for the afternoon crash. Two things make this funnel different: it ships under a neutral brand called Everyday Well, with no Nueva mark on it anywhere, so you can post it into a group. And the people who ask you for the second guide are the ones worth your time, because asking costs them something. You get a text when it happens. Your check ins are on day 3, day 8 and day 14, and they are about how she is doing, never about the download.
